quote: I've had the pleasure of working with Parwez and witnessing his growth firsthand. Parwez is incredibly hardworking and trustworthy. When he commits to something, he dedicates all his energy to meeting deadlines with the highest quality. He is highly proactive and has an eagerness to learn. During his time with SPAN, Parwez has mastered almost all the products SPAN offers and developed a strong functional and technical understanding of the solutions.
